title: Lab Operations & Administration Engineer at PS-CC/EDT-IN
text:
Company Description
In India, Bosch is a leading supplier of technology and services in the areas of Mobility Solutions, Industrial Technology, Consumer Goods, and Energy and Building Technology. Additionally, Bosch has in India the largest development center outside Germany, for end-to-end engineering and technology solutions. The Bosch Group operates in India through twelve companies: Bosch Limited – the flagship company of the Bosch Group in India – Bosch Chassis Systems India Private Limited, Bosch Rexroth (India) Private Limited, Bosch Global Software Technologies, Bosch Automotive Electronics India Private Limited, Bosch Electrical Drives India Private Limited, BSH Home Appliances Private Limited, ETAS Automotive India Private Limited, Robert Bosch Automotive Steering Private Limited, Automobility Services and Solutions Private Limited, Newtech Filter India Private Limited and Mivin Engg.Technologies Private Limited. In India, Bosch set-up its manufacturing operation in 1951, which has grown over the years to include 16 manufacturing sites, and seven development and application centers. The Bosch Group in India employs over 30,500 associates and generated consolidated sales of about Rs. 26,827 crores (3.1 billion euros) in fiscal year 2021-22 of which Rs. 24,406 crores (2.8 billion euros) are from consolidated sales to third parties. Bosch Limited is the flagship company of the Bosch Group. It earned revenue of over Rs. 11,782 crores (1.39 billion euros) in fiscal year 2021-22.

Additional information can be accessed at www.bosch.in
Job Description
Purpose of this position is to coordinate & execute product testing at lab & provide necessary data/results based on test specification and project requirements according to set standards.
Qualifications
Diploma in Mechanical/Electrical/Civil discipline
Additional Information
1+ years experience in Lab operations, administrative area. Good coordinating skills on request processing, scheduling & implementation 
5S implementation and Sustenance 
Procurement support
Test benches & instruments maintenance log
Nature of work calls for the candidate to be flexible and agile, with high customer/project orientation.  Candidate should be able to work in teams to achieve the results.

Job Description
The Digital Service Engineer is responsible for the shopfloor IT interface, OT Infrastructure and C&D technologies in the plant. Responsible to maintain a long-term roadmap for the life cycle management of these systems and technologies, to be in line with the global strategies and standards of central MTE. 
▪  Responsible to provide expert level support on DS and C&D technologies (as per the attached RASI) in order to fulfill committed production plans and ensure adherence to MTE@Tires standard processes. 

▪  Ensures the implementation and maintenance of Generic Technical Equipment Standards for all new installations and upgrades of equipment (m/c) including Manufacturing IT Systems in his area. 

▪  Responsible for the electrical acceptance of new machines and major upgrades in his area.

▪  Ensures and maintains the adherance of all shopfloor systems as per the cybersecurity policy in his area.

▪  Responsible to drive the machine connections and provide the needed data from the machines to the IT systems to get benefit out of big data for continuous improvement to increase manufacturing efficiency
Qualifications
Bachelor of electrical engineering or equivalent

At least 5 years Experience in Industrial Automation, IT  engineering experience in production industry
Additional Information
Has lead several machine improvement, refurbishment, upgrade or installation projects

Experience managing teams either Maintenance or Projects.

International team capability

Fluent English skills in written and spoken

title: AI & Cloud Consultant
text:
Company Description
Bosch Global Software Technologies Private Limited is a 100% owned subsidiary of Robert Bosch GmbH, one of the world's leading global supplier of technology and services, offering end-to-end Engineering, IT and Business Solutions. With over 28,200+ associates, it’s the largest software development center of Bosch, outside Germany, indicating that it is the Technology Powerhouse of Bosch in India with a global footprint and presence in the US, Europe and the Asia Pacific region.
Job Description
Job Description
As a Cloud & AI Consultant, you will drive the adoption of cloud and AI technologies to solve complex business challenges and enable digital transformation. The role combines business consulting, cloud technology, AI/GenAI, integration, and solution architecture to deliver scalable, secure, and business-value-driven solutions.
Key Responsibilities:

Understand business challenges and translate them into cloud, AI, and digital solution opportunities.

Design and implement scalable solutions using cloud platforms, AI/GenAI, APIs, integration, and modern application technologies.

Identify opportunities to apply Generative AI, Agentic AI, automation, and intelligent applications to improve business processes and user experience.

Work with Cloud ecosystem technologies to extend and integrate enterprise applications where applicable.

Define solution architecture, technology choices, integration patterns, and implementation approaches aligned with enterprise standards.

Develop PoCs, prototypes, and MVPs to validate innovative cloud and AI use cases and accelerate adoption.

Collaborate with business stakeholders, architects, product teams, developers, and external technology partners.

Evaluate emerging technologies and assess their applicability, maturity, risks, and business value.

Ensure solutions address key aspects such as security, scalability, data privacy, performance, maintainability, and cost optimization.

Create reusable accelerators, frameworks, patterns, and knowledge assets to enable adoption across projects and teams.

Contribute to technology communities, competency development, mentoring, and knowledge-sharing initiatives.

Support customers and internal stakeholders in defining cloud and AI roadmaps and transformation strategies.
Core Technical Skills
Cloud

Strong understanding of cloud concepts, cloud-native architecture, and services.

Experience with one or more major cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.

Understanding of containers, APIs, microservices, serverless technologies, and cloud security.
AI / GenAI

Understanding of Generative AI, LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG, AI agents, embeddings, and vector databases.

Experience developing or integrating AI-powered applications and services.

Understanding of responsible AI, data privacy, security, and AI governance.
Engineering

Programming experience in technologies such as Python, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript or ABAP.

Experience with REST APIs, event-driven architecture, Git, CI/CD, and DevOps practices.

Understanding of databases, data platforms, and data integration.
Consulting & Leadership Competencies

Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking with the ability to move from problem identification to solution shaping.

Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.

Ability to translate complex technology concepts into business outcomes and value propositions.

Customer-centric mindset with strong consulting and influencing skills.

Ability to work effectively in cross-functional and distributed teams.

Curiosity and continuous learning mindset toward emerging cloud and AI technologies.

Ability to take end-to-end ownership and drive solutions from ideation ? PoC ? MVP ? production adoption.
Experience & Qualifications

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.

Typically 14+ years of experience in IT consulting, cloud eng
